Your holdings: SMCI (-45.91%), SOXL (-83.41%), and PLTU (-35.47%) are deep in the red and flagged for attention. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep an eye on SMCI and SOXL. Their current trajectory is concerning given your concentrated tech/chip focus.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your biggest losers and the risk they pose.
plays: Trim SMCI: Consider reducing exposure given the significant drawdown and negative momentum.
Trim SOXL: The leveraged nature and deep losses here warrant a serious look at reducing size.
Consider trimming PLTU: Leveraged ETFs decay, and this one is deep in the red.
